company.name: TileGreen
company.shortDescription: TileGreen offers thermomechanical modular technology for producing durable building materials from mechanically unrecyclable plastic waste.
company.description: TileGreen is a manufacturing technology company that invented a patented, machine-learning-based, and automated thermomechanical modular technology (TG1.0) that acts as a platform for producing more than 100 circular, economic, and durable building materials (recycled-polymer-aggregate-composite) from all types of mechanically unrecyclable plastic waste at a green discount, not a green premium. Re-PAC material doesn’t crack, rot, rust, erode, or interact with chemicals, which makes it a durable, economical, and green alternative for multiple concrete, clay, wood, and metal non-structural applications.

productsAndServices.description: A technology that converts mechanically unrecyclable plastic waste into durable building materials through a thermomechanical process.
